svg.title: p-type dopants in beta-Ga2O3: the real monoclinic crystal, two unit cells deep, its atoms in room-temperature thermal motion to scale; a dopant sits first on a tetrahedral Ga(I) site with four oxygen bonds, then on an octahedral Ga(II) site with six. Graph neural networks over the defect's real structure; abstract under review at IIM ATM 2026.
svg.text: Teaching a network the shape of a defect · under review, IIM ATM 2026
